messages:
zoe: Hey team — just wrapped a quick customer interview with Sapling Inc. Recording + raw transcript here: https://drive.redwood.ai/sapling/interview. Need redlines, public-safe quote, short social hero (30s), webinar snippet (2x20s), captions (EN/KR), press checklist, and lead-routing tags. Can legal + ops weigh in?

ian: Great timing. They said specifically 'cut inference spend in half in production' and mentioned internal feature flags. Legal will want the public line softened. Also asked for logo placement on the landing.

sam: For the webinar we want one slide with a safe stat and a follow-up date 2026-05-18. Ops: can you add UTMs and route demo requests from the asset to Rachel?

legal-bot: Automated review: NDA present, release template `customer-release-v2` required. Redact feature flag names, internal request IDs, and any hostnames. Recommend public quote phrasing: "reduced inference costs by ~50%". If Sapling insists on exact numbers, require signed telemetry addendum. Final legal sign-off requires the redlined transcript attached to the release.

ops-bot: Caption vendor options: RapidCaption (24h auto + 1h human QC) or NativeLingo (48-72h human). Ops recommends RapidCaption for speed so we can meet the webinar timeline. Proposed UTMs: `?utm_campaign=sapling_case&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social`. Routing rule: tag `cs-warm` -> assign to AE Rachel (rachel@redwood.ai), priority high-touch. Will stage pixel and HubSpot flow once embargo time confirmed.

ian: I'll draft two public-safe quote options and send to Sapling: (A) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~50% while improving response times." (B) "We saw meaningful latency and cost improvements after moving to Redwood." Which should we push as default?

zoe: Send both and ask them to OK the public wording and logo usage. For social copy, prefer option A. Also ask for quick approval on a short 30s hero clip.

ae-rachel: FYI I'll prepare outreach templates for hot leads and the post-webinar nurture. Once routing is live I can pick up warm demos immediately.

sam: Deliverables + ETA: Ian to send quote options now, Zoe to collect signed release, Ops to stage tracking by EOD tomorrow, Creative to produce hero_30s + 2x20s clips by EOD today. Embargo proposal: 2026-05-10 10:00 PT.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach the redlined transcript to the release form. Legal will mark green after signed PDF and transcript are received.

ian: Sent quotes to Sapling and BCC'd legal. Asking for approval within 48h.

zoe: Sapling replied: approves option A, grants logo use, and uploaded a signed release (uploading to Drive now). They asked we avoid any internal feature names in the copy.

ops-bot: Received signed release and staging assets. Pixel and HubSpot flow created and tested. Routing test passes: `cs-warm` leads assign to Rachel.

legal-bot: Redlined transcript attached and reviewed. No PII detected in public copy. Telemetry addendum not required. Legal flips final sign-off to green.

sam: Great — embargo cleared. Ops please schedule landing publish + social posts at 2026-05-10 10:00 PT and include webinar CTA for 2026-05-18 deep-dive. Also stage press kit assets in the comms folder.

ops-bot: Scheduled landing and social queue for embargo time. UTMs and pixel live. Press kit staged at https://drive.redwood.ai/sapling/press. Routing rules live.

zoe: Thanks team — closing loop. I'll follow up with Sapling on publish day for any press or partner intros. :tada:
